description: Local tunnel configuration management via config YAML

requirements.title: Parse existing cloudflared config
requirements.description: Read and parse ~/.cloudflared/config.yml to extract current ingress rules, tunnel ID, and credentials file path

requirements.title: YAML parsing and ingress extraction
requirements.description: Parse config.yml YAML format and extract ingress rules array

requirements.title: Malformed config error handling
requirements.description: Return descriptive errors when config.yml has invalid YAML syntax or missing required fields

requirements.title: Tunnel metadata extraction
requirements.description: Extract tunnel ID and credentials file path from config alongside ingress rules

requirements.title: Generate config from route manifest
requirements.description: Convert the route manifest to a valid cloudflared config.yml with proper ingress rules and catch-all. Preserve non-ingress settings (tunnel ID, credentials, warp-routing, etc.).

requirements.title: Ingress rule generation
requirements.description: Convert each route entry to a cloudflared ingress rule with hostname and service mapping

requirements.title: Non-ingress setting preservation
requirements.description: Preserve tunnel ID, credentials path, warp-routing, and other non-ingress settings during config generation

requirements.title: Catch-all rule inclusion
requirements.description: Always include a catch-all service rule as the last ingress entry in generated config

requirements.title: Config write with backup
requirements.description: Before overwriting config.yml, create a timestamped backup (config.yml.backup.YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS). Keep last 5 backups.

requirements.title: Timestamped backup creation
requirements.description: Create backup file named config.yml.backup.YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS before overwriting

requirements.title: Backup rotation
requirements.description: Keep last 5 backups and automatically remove older ones

requirements.title: Restart after config change
requirements.description: After writing config.yml in local mode, restart cloudflared via systemctl and verify /ready returns 200
